part.text:
Fixed. The root cause: in `ChildDiff.prototype.diffChildren` (src/clone-element.js:109-138), children are only turned into text VNodes when `typeof` is `string`/`number`/`bigint`. A `String` wrapper object instead fell through to `diff()`, where the `newVNode.constructor !== undefined` guard (src/diff/index.js:45) bailed out immediately because the object's constructor is `String` — so nothing rendered. The fix adds `childVNode instanceof String` to the text-node branch, so String objects are treated as text just like primitives (matching React's behavior). This covers both `
{new String('hi')}
` and components returning `new String(...)`. Validation: - Full karma browser suite: 1080 tests pass, including the previously failing `should render a new String()`; the only remaining failure (`focus` capture event) is pre-existing on the baseline and environment-related. - `npm run test:mocha` (29 passing), `tsc -p test/ts/`, and `eslint` are all clean.
